title: The Ghost Army of World War II
caption:
The US Army fooled Hitler with inflatable tanks. 🎈

The men behind it were artists, and their secret stayed buried for decades.

Should trickery count as heroism? Tell us below 👇

scenes.say: The US Army fooled Hitler with inflatable tanks. And that wasn't even their best trick.
They were called the Ghost Army. About 1,100 American soldiers, activated in January 1944.
Many were artists from art schools, including future fashion designer Bill Blass and painter Ellsworth Kelly.
Their job: impersonate entire divisions, using inflatable tanks pumped up by air compressors.
After D-Day, two Frenchmen on bicycles slipped past the guards. They saw four soldiers lift a 40-ton Sherman tank.
They faked sound too: 500-pound speakers, heard up to 15 miles away.
Radio operators sent phony messages. Soldiers wore fake patches and leaked false rumors.
In March 1945, at the Rhine, 1,100 men pretended to be over 30,000, drawing Germans away from the real crossing.
They ran more than 20 operations, saving an estimated 15,000 to 30,000 American lives.
But their work stayed secret for decades.
In 2024, they finally received the Congressional Gold Medal. Should trickery count as heroism? Tell me in the comments.

characters.artist: thin young white American soldier aged 22, dark side-parted hair, olive drab 1944 US Army uniform with garrison cap, sketchbook and pencil

shots.prompt: Low angle across a misty 1944 French field: four young American soldiers effortlessly lifting a full-size Sherman tank over their heads, the tank clearly an inflatable rubber dummy, astonishing sight
shots.action: Four soldiers hoist the huge rubber tank above their heads and turn it slowly as mist drifts across the field

shots.prompt: Wide shot of a long row of Sherman tanks under camouflage nets at the edge of a forest at dawn in 1944 France, seen from far away, convincing and menacing
shots.action: Morning fog rolls slowly past the row of tanks while the camouflage nets ripple in the breeze

shots.prompt: Aerial view of a 1944 US Army camp at Camp Forrest, Tennessee: rows of canvas tents and hundreds of soldiers assembling in formation, winter light
shots.action: Columns of soldiers march across the parade ground between rows of canvas tents

shots.prompt: [artist] sitting on an army crate sketching a French farmhouse in a sketchbook, other soldiers painting a canvas dummy truck behind him, warm afternoon light, 1944
shots.action: [artist] sketches quickly with his pencil while the soldiers behind him brush paint onto the dummy truck

shots.prompt: A deflated olive drab rubber tank lying flat on the grass, soldiers hooking up a gas-powered air compressor to it, hoses snaking across the ground, 1944 France
shots.action: The flat rubber tank swells and rises off the grass as the compressor pumps air into it

shots.prompt: Two French civilians on old bicycles, one of them [frenchman], pedaling down a hedgerow lane in Normandy in summer 1944, peering through a gap in the hedge
shots.action: The two men pedal slowly along the lane, then brake and stare through the gap in the hedge

shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind [frenchman]: four American soldiers in a field lifting and turning a 40-ton-looking Sherman tank by hand, his jaw dropping
shots.action: The soldiers rotate the tank in place as [frenchman] slowly lowers his bicycle in disbelief

shots.prompt: Night in a dark 1944 forest: a huge loudspeaker mounted on a US Army half-track, aimed into the trees, soldiers adjusting dials, moonlight through branches
shots.action: The giant speaker vibrates as sound booms out and leaves tremble on the branches in the moonlight

shots.prompt: Inside a 1944 army radio tent at night, a soldier wearing headphones tapping a Morse code key, glowing radio sets and a lamp, focused face
shots.action: The soldier taps the Morse key rapidly as the radio dials glow and the lamp light flickers

shots.prompt: A small 1944 French village cafe: [artist] in uniform with a fake division patch on his shoulder, chatting with locals over wine, a curious man listening at the next table
shots.action: [artist] leans in and talks quietly while the man at the next table turns his head to listen

shots.prompt: Night along the Rhine River in March 1945: hundreds of dummy tanks and trucks lined up on the riverbank, distant searchlights in the sky, wide epic shot
shots.action: Searchlights sweep slowly across the night sky above the long rows of dummy tanks on the riverbank

shots.prompt: German officers in long grey coats studying the far riverbank through binoculars from a ruined building at dusk, 1945, smoke on the horizon
shots.action: The officer lowers his binoculars slowly while smoke drifts across the horizon behind him

shots.prompt: Map table in a 1945 US Army headquarters tent with pins and arrows across Europe, a hand moving a small wooden tank marker, lamp light
shots.action: A hand slides the wooden tank marker across the map as the lamp swings gently overhead

shots.prompt: A thick army file folder with a red classified stamp being locked inside a steel filing cabinet in a dim 1945 office, dust in the air
shots.action: The steel drawer slides shut and a key turns in the lock as dust floats through the light

shots.prompt: Elderly American veterans in suits and army caps standing proudly in a grand marble hall of the US Capitol, a gold medal on display, warm light
shots.action: The veterans stand tall and smile as the camera pulls back through the grand marble hall
